body:
## Prove the Loop Can Learn

The program runs without errors, yet loss never falls. Successful execution is not proof that training works.

First try to overfit one tiny batch. If the model cannot memorize that small sample, inspect labels, output shape, loss choice, gradients, and optimizer order.

Then restore normal train and validation splits. Record loss and a task-appropriate metric for both.
common_mistakes: A model learns merely because its script exits successfully.
Only the final accuracy number is needed to reproduce a run.
Validation rows should be used for every weight update.

real_world_usage: This capstone proves the learner can connect Phase 5’s parts into a working training system.
